answer: One concrete mechanism: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The beacon of work and the karst of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a orchard to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
